items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Cliff Leeman) narrates a story about Trummy Young being in Louis Armstrong's band, but does not state any personal interaction or professional relationship between himself and Trummy Young.

ctx.x: Oh, yes; that's the way Barnet wanted it. That's the way it was.
What was the percentage? What -- who were the blacks in the band? Trummy Young.
Well, we had so many bands and so many different musicians.
